CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Quote_Document_Row__c API name this column reads, e.g. Amount_Net__c or Product_Code__c. ANY readable field qualifies, including one your org added itself - that is how a subscriber prints their own data with no core change. Leave BLANK for the label column, which prints the row's Display Label. A measure belonging to a different measure set than the table fails with COLUMN_MEASURE_MISMATCH.
CustomField.label: Value Field
